overview: Euclid DR1 produced a 15,072-object strong-lens catalogue and segmentation tools, while new benchmarks (COSMIO, FAIR Universe weak lensing) test cross-survey imputation and uncertainty-aware cosmology. Simulation-based inference with normalizing flows and neural posterior estimation appears across DESI N(z), DES Y3 3PCF, LISA, gravitational-wave tests of general relativity, FRB cosmology and exoplanet retrieval. Neural operators and surrogates target MHD turbulence, rotating neutron stars and supernova equations of state; foundation-model and contrastive/JEPA representations target light curves, spectra and survey photometry.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens catalogues and segmentation
